import sys,json,csv,io,base64

 s=io.StringIO(newline='');w=csv.writer(s,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(HDR)
 for r in rows:w.writerow(r)
 return {'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(s.getvalue().encode()).decode()]}

 return ['icmp',rid,'0',str(pub),'put','h',str(event),probe,target,resp,result,'','','']
def app(rid,pub,event,target,result,service,attempt=0):
 return ['app',rid,'0',str(pub),'put','h',str(event),'','2001:db8:1:1200::'+target,'',result,service,str(attempt),'']
rows=[
 icmp('i1',10,1,'0/i1','2001:db8:1:1200::1','2001:db8:1:1200::1','echo'),

 'services':[{'id':'t','kind':'tcp'},{'id':'a','kind':'adb'}],'queries':[10,20],
